legacy_migration.blocking: Keep each receiver layer in a stable zone and keep the display line traceable; do not infer institutional roles from seating alone

legacy_migration.failure_mode: Fragmented reactions arrive before spatial registration; receiver layers become an equal-weight face montage; zone/eyeline drift obscures presenter/challenged relation; picture labels invent legal roles
